title: Volume Label

illustrates.quote: Most labels are limited to 30 cells and 2-4 lines.

blocks.text: The Seven Wonders of the World
blocks.features: Volume-cover label, first line: book title.
Volume-cover label, second line: abbreviated volume number and inclusive print page range.

braille.notes: Two lines, verbatim, no line numbers shown; within the 2-4 line / 30-cell label limit of 1.17.3, not a normal 40-cell braille page. Line 1 the title in full; line 2 'Volume 5: 105-145' (the abbreviated print label 'V5' expanded to 'Volume 5' in braille, with inclusive print pages 105-145).

resolution: Both runs agree on wording. This is a volume COVER LABEL (BANA 1.17: vertical label applied to a volume cover, at most 30 cells / 2-4 lines), not an ordinary 40-cell text page -- and Emboss's own volume-label generator (cover.mjs) is dead code, unreachable from the app (standards-findings.md F-59). status: not-representable (F-59; also the 30-cell width itself does not match this runner's fixed 40-cell OPTS).
